title: Project Work Performance Domain
coreMove: Manage project work as a live system: trace flow, procurement, resources, knowledge, and decisions until the evidence shows useful work can move.

exampleSpecs.audience: project managers coordinating vendors and internal teams
exampleSpecs.stakes: a green task board could hide procurement and resource drag
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A short message exchange reveals work flow, procurement, resources, and knowledge signals before a supplier call

exampleSpecs.domain: PMO review of a multi-team release
exampleSpecs.stakes: the meeting could treat Project Work as a sequence box instead of an interacting domain
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A routine status review stops and restarts around the PMBOK Guide's 8 domains

exampleSpecs.stakes: small physical details reveal the domain signal better than a status summary
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A close observation of a queue surfaces work flow, procurement, resources, and knowledge without a formal decision

exampleSpecs.domain: failed operations handoff after a release
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may blame a delivery miss while missing the Project Work interaction that caused it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The failure is reconstructed through the PMBOK Guide's 8 domains to locate the decisive misstep

exampleSpecs.stakes: the lead could mistake visible flow for enough domain health
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Aurora notices her own error mid-stream and corrects the readiness review

exampleSpecs.domain: steering decision for a hybrid implementation
exampleSpecs.stakes: leaders may add artifacts instead of adjusting the work system
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written memo carries the decision to tailor Project Work through PMBOK Guide domain interactions
